title.page: V4.0.1 - Data Center Digital Twin Design
tree.empty_project: ⚪ No models — import an STL or create a default box from the top-left buttons
tree.sort_tooltip: Feature-tree ordering: name ascending → name descending → manual (drag) order. Name sorting is natural, so Rack_C2 comes before Rack_C10.
tree.sort_switched_manual: Drag reorder: switched to manual ordering
hint.max_cells_desc: snappyHexMesh maxGlobalCells — refinement stops when this limit is reached.
hint.refinement_desc: Surface [min, max]: controls mesh density near geometry surfaces. Feature line: controls density near edges/corners (recommended >= surface max).
hint.blockmesh_desc: Manually set the blockMesh bounding box (m).
hint.blockmesh_drag: 🖱️ Hover to highlight face borders; drag to resize. Switch to move mode in the right panel.
hint.refinement_zones_desc: Define searchableBox refinement zones. Drag faces to resize, drag center sphere to move.
hint.location_desc: A point inside the fluid domain (snappyHexMesh keeps the mesh on this side). Drag the orange sphere in the viewport.
hint.extra_seeds_desc: Mark additional connected fluid regions (all in none mode).
dialog.floor_height_error_desc: The following floor/ceiling objects have Y-coordinates exceeding room.height (Y-up convention: Y is the vertical axis). Room enclosure walls only extend to room.height — geometry above that will be unclosed, causing mesh generation to fail. Adjust the room height in the 2D Floor Plan.
dialog.floor_height_error_item: Floor '{name}' is at y={y}, but room height is only {roomHeight}
status.floor_height_error: ❌ Room height conflicts with floor geometry. Adjust room height and retry.
dialog.room_wall_gap_title: Room Walls Do Not Span Floor to Room Height
dialog.room_wall_gap_desc: The following room enclosure walls do not span the full height from the room floor to room.height (Y-up convention: Y is the vertical axis): their top is below the room height, or their bottom is above the room floor. The gap to the ceiling or to the floor leaves the room unclosed — fluid leaks through it to the mesh bounding box, and the room walls, floor and ceiling can drop out of the mesh boundary (a dcCart mesh keeps only domain_* patches). Extend these walls down to the floor and up to the room height.
dialog.room_wall_gap_item: Wall '{name}' ends at y={top}, but room height is {roomHeight}
dialog.room_wall_gap_span_item: Wall '{name}' spans y={bottom} to y={top}, but the room runs from its floor at y={floor} to the room height {roomHeight}
btn.room_wall_gap_extend: Extend Walls to Floor and Room Height
status.room_wall_gap_error: ❌ Room walls do not span the room from its floor to its height, so the room enclosure is open. Extend the walls and retry.
hint.seed_helper_desc: Default seeds use plane center ± normal offset. Drag the center hub to slide the whole seed pair on the current plane; drag either arrow tip to update both seeds symmetrically about the current anchor.
hint.solver_no_select: 🔬 In solver mode, geometry cannot be selected — easier to drag the locationInMesh sphere.
hint.solver_no_select_short: 🔬 Geometry selection disabled in solver mode
transient.mode.title: Simulation: steady, or transient with a timeline and keyframes
transient.mode.air_hint: switch it in the top bar (air view)
transient.mode.liquid_hint: switch it in the top bar (liquid view)
transient.mode.liquid_own_clock: the DAE marches on the experiment's own duration, not the timeline keyframes; choose Transient in the top bar (liquid view) to follow the timeline, Steady for a single operating point
transient.start.title: Transient start: from the converged steady field, or from a uniform initial field
transient.bar.title: Click or drag to move the playhead; Left/Right seek one grid step, Home/End seek the start/end. Drag a diamond to shift every keyframe at that time, double-click it for an exact time
transient.exact_time: Exact keyframe time (s), Enter to apply
transient.grid.help: Sets playhead and keyframe snapping. CFD adaptive time steps are configured separately. Existing keyframes and ramp starts must align; stored times are never moved.
transient.refusal.grid_conflict: existing keyframes or ramp starts do not align with this step; choose a compatible step
transient.trim_confirm: Shortening the timeline to {d} s deletes the {n} keyframe(s) after it. Continue?
transient.tracks_toggle_title: Show / hide the parameter tracks of the selected object
transient.tracks.pick: Select an object in the tree or the viewport to see its parameter tracks
transient.tracks.air_steady: Air runs steady: air keyframes do not drive the solve until air is switched to transient in the top bar.
transient.tracks.liquid_steady: Liquid runs steady: liquid keyframes do not drive the run until liquid is switched to transient in the top bar.
transient.tracks.none: The selected object has no time-variable parameters in this mode
transient.key.add: Add a keyframe at the playhead (current value)
transient.key.ramp_handle: Drag: where the linear ramp from the previous value into this keyframe starts
transient.badge.key: ◆ A keyframe at this time: an edit rewrites it
transient.badge.ramp: ◐ Inside a ramp (interpolated value): an edit adds a keyframe here
transient.badge.hold: ◇ Held from the previous keyframe: an edit adds a keyframe here
transient.refusal.static: off the start, geometry and static fields are read-only (go back to t = 0 to change them)
transient.refusal.structure: objects and parameters can only be added or removed at the start (t = 0)
transient.refusal.trim: keyframes lie past the new duration
transient.refusal.onto_start: a keyframe cannot move onto the start
transient.refusal.after_end: a keyframe cannot go past the end of the timeline
transient.refusal.key_exists: there is already a keyframe at that time
transient.refusal.start_undeletable: the start keyframe cannot be deleted
transient.refusal.grid_positive: the seek step must be finite and greater than 0
transient.refusal.invalid_start: the start must be the steady converged field or a uniform field
transient.refusal.needs_start: every track needs a t = 0 keyframe without a ramp
transient.refusal.ramp_gap: the ramp is longer than the gap to the previous keyframe
transient.refusal.off_grid: time not on the {grid} s grid
transient.frozen.banner: t = {t} s: geometry and static fields are read-only; fields marked ◆ ◐ ◇ write a keyframe at this time
transient.solver.hybrid_hint: the top bar is transient (the liquid run marches in time); the air solve stays steady
transient.solver.mode_hint: switch steady / transient in the top bar
transient.solver.duration_hint: {d} s (set at the right end of the timeline)
transient.liquid.duration_hint: {d} s (set by the timeline in a transient project)
transient.liquid.keyframe_hint: In a transient project, load and primary-inlet temperature changes are keyframes on the cold-plate heat / primary inlet temperature tracks in the timeline
hint.parallel_solve_desc: Solve cores can be set independently from mesh generation; current mesh parallel status:
hint.gravity_desc: Set gravity direction and magnitude (m/s²). Default: negative Y-axis (Y-up convention).
hint.preset_desc: Fast=1st-order upwind | Balanced=2nd-order linearUpwind (recommended) | Accurate=3rd-order TVD
hint.piso_no_relaxation: PISO mode (nOuterCorrectors=1) does not need relaxation factors
hint.residual_desc: Set convergence residual thresholds for each variable. The solver stops when all initial residuals fall below these thresholds.
hint.residual_desc_transient: Each time step repeats outer iterations until every field starts an iteration below its threshold, or the per-step maximum is reached, then moves on. With the momentum predictor off U is not solved on its own and its threshold has no effect.
hint.mesh_quality_required: This mesh has not passed the full quality check. Check the existing mesh or generate it again before solving.
hint.postprocess_desc: 📊 Post-processing: visualize CFD results (temperature, velocity, streamlines).
tooltip.toggle_lights: Toggle scene lights (affects 3D models and post-processing)
inspector.title: ⚙️ Property Inspector
dialog.solve_partition_desc: The current solver settings cannot directly reuse the existing mesh partitions.
dialog.solve_partition_counts: Existing mesh: {mesh} partitions; requested solve: {solve} core(s).
dialog.solve_partition_parallel: Continuing will reconstruct the mesh and repartition it for the requested solver core count, adding startup time.
dialog.solve_partition_serial: This solve will run in serial. Continuing will reconstruct the mesh first, adding startup time.
dialog.solve_partition_hint: To reuse the existing partitions, go back, enable parallel solving and set the solver core count to {mesh}. You do not need to regenerate the mesh.
status.solve_partition_cancelled: Solve cancelled. Adjust the solver core count and try again.
error.solve_partition_check_failed: Could not read the mesh partition information. Check the backend connection and check the mesh again.
dialog.seed_collision_desc: Some seeds may fall inside the approximate bounding boxes of room objects. This is a coarse AABB precheck for warning only; if you have visually verified the placement, you can ignore it and continue meshing.
dialog.seed_collision_item: The {side} seed may fall inside {objectType} object {objectName} at ({x}, {y}, {z})
dialog.server_refinement_desc: The following server face refinement levels are insufficient. snappyHexMesh may fail to capture these patches, causing solver errors.
status.seed_collision_cancelled: Mesh submission cancelled. Adjust the seed positions and try again.

error.project_v5_react_only: This project is cfdproj v5 (with transient keyframes); open it in the React editor.
error.enter_case_dir: Please enter a case working directory
error.invalid_min_max: Please enter valid Min < Max values
error.select_run_and_step: Please select a solve record and time step first

error.select_at_least_one: Please select at least one model.

confirm.split_equipment: The current selection is in the middle of {name}. Continuing will split this equipment into two separate patches. Continue?
inspector.bounds_desc: When checked, all models' bounds (position + size) must stay within the axis limit. Unchecked axes are unconstrained.
inspector.stl_filename_hint: This name is used for merged export (the .stl suffix is added automatically).
inspector.project_name_hint: Used when saving .cfdproj files and exporting CFD packages.
inspector.sensor_data_hint: Real-world sensor readings, reference only — not used by the solver.
inspector.import_hint: Click the top-left button to import more STL files. New imports are added as root nodes in the project.
inspector.dctwin_start_hint: Please start with start_server.sh (requires dcdtuni conda environment)
filebrowser.title: 📂 Select Server Directory
filebrowser.desc: Browse the server filesystem to choose a directory for the Case
filebrowser.selected_placeholder: Double-click a folder to enter, or type a path here
inspector.room_temp_desc: Set the ambient reference temperature, affecting TRef and thermal expansion coefficient beta (= 1/TRef).
inspector.patch_anchor_hint: ⚓ Anchor: bottom-left corner (rect) or centre (circle); drawn as the red ball in 3D, editable below
inspector.patch_anchor_world_hint: The anchor (rect: bottom-left corner, circle: centre) in the room's global frame. Edits are converted back to face coordinates; any part off the face plane is projected onto it.
hint.floor_return: This patch is solved as a pressure outlet (acu_return): air leaves the room here. The flow rate is informational; the outlet flow follows the pressure field.
hint.face_texture: Put a picture on this face (a cabinet door photo, say). Display only — the CFD boundary condition is unchanged. The image is scaled to 1024 px on its longest side and saved with the project.
hint.load_texture_local: Pick an image (PNG/JPG/WebP) from this computer; it is embedded in the project file.
pipe.hint_drag: In the viewport: drag the end balls (blue/red) to move the pipe ends and the yellow balls to move bends; drop an end near another pipe's end to snap and join it (a reducer is added when the bores differ). Move the whole pipe with the move tool.
hint.acu_wall_mounted: A wall-mounted unit has left/right ends, a top and one continuous front that bends into the bottom; a rectangular patch on the front is the louvred outlet (coordinates along the unrolled surface), its supply angle is set in the patch panel.
inspector.move_hint: Click to drag this geometry directly in the viewport. Uncheck an axis to lock its coordinate.
inspector.unit_hint: Internal geometry is stored in meters. Current input/display unit: {unit}.
hint.rack_server_opacity_desc: Sets every server in this rack at once. The rack slider above fades the frame, blanking panels and doors only.
hint.floor_zero_thickness: Floor is a zero-thickness horizontal plane. Use Anchor Z to control its height position.
hint.polygon_floor_edit: Floor shape defined by polygon vertices. Use the 2D Floor Plan Editor to modify.
hint.wall_zero_thickness: Wall is a zero-thickness plane used to define room boundaries. The room polygon is auto-derived during CFD export.
hint.baffle_zero_thickness: Baffle is a zero-thickness plane, exported as a single-layer triangle sheet.
hint.surface_patch_desc: Add named region patches on the {surface} surface. Each patch is exported as an independent STL solid.
hint.auto_floor_diff: Auto-detect all models overlapping the floor plane and subtract their footprint from the floor.
hint.auto_wall_diff: Auto-detect all models penetrating the {kind} plane and subtract their projection from the {kind}.
hint.acu_bc_desc: Supply: flowRateInletVelocity + fixedValue T; Return: flowRateOutletVelocity + zeroGradient T
hint.acu_no_patches: Please add patches on a face first to configure supply/return surfaces.
hint.box_wall_role: Wall: an impermeable obstruction in the flow; it generates no heat.
hint.wall_object_desc: Wall object defaults all faces to wall condition. To set a heat-emitting face, configure the corresponding patch.
label.baffle_wall: Internal wall baffle (keeps mesh on both sides)
label.baffle_perforated: Perforated wall baffle (keeps mesh on both sides)
hint.perforated_desc: Porous baffle generates cyclic master/slave patches with porousBafflePressure boundary condition.
hint.partition_wall_role: Thick solid partition wall. Holes cut fully through; no mesh is kept inside the wall body.
hint.partition_wall_leakage: 0% = maximum resistance, 100% = zero resistance. Delete the patch to make it fully sealed.
label.floor_wall: Solid wall (keeps mesh on one side)
label.floor_wall_baffle: Internal wall baffle (keeps mesh on both sides)
label.floor_perforated: Perforated wall baffle (keeps mesh on both sides)
hint.bc_wall: Solid wall: keeps mesh on one side only, the other side is removed. Suitable for room floor boundaries.
hint.bc_wall_baffle: Internal wall baffle: mesh on both sides preserved, forms internal face with no-slip condition. Suitable for raised floors.
hint.bc_perforated: Perforated wall baffle: mesh on both sides preserved, generates master/slave cyclic patches with porousBafflePressure. Suitable for perforated floors.
hint.patch_bc_wall: Solid wall, removes mesh on one side
hint.patch_bc_wall_baffle: Internal wall baffle, both sides preserved, no-slip
hint.surface_orientation_legend: Green arrow = room interior. Red arrow = room exterior. If the current enclosure direction is wrong, flip this face below.
hint.surface_orientation_desc: This control flips the STL facet winding and normals for the selected wall/floor surface only. It does not move the model, resize it, or perform a geometric mirror.
hint.box_opacity_desc: Model opacity is synced to all internal faces and wall regions. The rendered opacity follows each face/wall's own value.
hint.custom_patch_desc: Add projection beams at the model level. After positioning, execute Bool Diff in the patch properties.
inspector.multi_select_hint: {count} models selected. You can move them together or execute Bool Diff.
inspector.batch_hint: Use the top toolbar for rotate/mirror — transforms are applied around the first selected model's anchor.
inspector.min_point_hint: Bounding box minimum corner of all selected models. Changing a value translates all models by the delta. You can also drag any selected model in the viewport.
bool.title: ⚙️ Bool Diff (Boolean Subtraction)
bool.target_warning: ⚠️ Target must be a floor or baffle type.
bool.desc:
With two models selected, you can subtract the overlapping region of the tool from the target.
Primarily used to cut out footprints on floors/baffles.
bool.target_warning_full: ⚠️ Target must be a floor or baffle type (planar geometry) to perform 2D Bool Diff.
hint.rack_opacity_desc: Lower opacity to see fan-server through-channels and internal partitions.
hint.rack_leakage_click: Click the orange through-cavity area or U-slot in the viewport to set the leakage coefficient per group.
hint.rack_no_leakage: No through-cavities. After deleting a U-slot, click "Sync Delete Opposite" in the Slot Actions panel to create a through-leakage zone.
hint.slot_face_desc: This face auto-generates selectable U-slots. Select a U-slot from the tree or viewport to add fan-server / non-fan equipment or delete surface.
hint.wall_face_desc: This face remains as an integral wall region.
hint.coord_tooltip_keys: Tab: focus/cycle inputs | Enter: preview | Space: place | Esc: cancel
hint.leakage_zone_desc: Both sides of this slot are deleted, forming a through-cavity. It will be exported as an independent STL leakage region (cellZone) for porousZone source terms.
hint.residual_opposite: {side} face restored, but {oppSide} face is still deleted.
hint.void_partition_desc: Add partitions at cavity boundaries to create independent solid regions.
hint.multi_slot_not_contiguous: Non-contiguous selection — only batch delete/restore is supported, not merging into a single device.
hint.multi_slot_can_split: Selection is in the middle of a device. Removing will split it into two separate patches.
hint.multi_slot_can_remove: Selection is at the edge of a device. These U-slots can be removed from the device.
hint.multi_slot_can_extend: Selection covers the entire device plus adjacent empty slots. The device can be extended.
hint.multi_slot_has_equipment: Selection contains equipment but is not in the "full device + adjacent slots" pattern for extension.
hint.multi_slot_can_merge: Contiguous selection — can be merged directly into a single equipment patch.
hint.multi_leakage_summary: {count} slots form through-cavities. {groups} leakage zone groups.
hint.multi_leakage_multi_group: Multiple leakage groups — click each orange area individually to configure.
hint.equipment_linkage: Inlet/outlet auto-linked. Fan-server also generates through-channels while maintaining watertight topology.
hint.fan_server_dt: Q = ρ·Cp·V̇·ΔT — specify any two, derive the third
hint.blanking_full_block: Empty U-slots are airtight walls (wall BC)
hint.blanking_small_gap: Simulates edge gap leakage on standard panels (σ≈5%, porousBafflePressure)
hint.non_fan_desc: Non-fan equipment applies fixed temperature (fixedValue T) BC on the selected face. No fan-driven airflow.
hint.unpowered_desc: Unpowered device: both faces use no-slip wall BC. No heat generation. Equivalent to multi-U blank panel.
hint.partition_desc: Partitions between two deleted U-slots are auto-removed. Fan-server spanning multiple U-slots also auto-removes internal horizontal partitions, keeping only top/bottom caps. Use buttons below for manual override.
hint.partition_deleted_status: When deleted, this partition will not appear in the exported STL.
hint.custom_proj_patch: 💡 Imported STL uses "projection patch" logic: set patch position and projection vector, and the shadow region will be extracted as a new solid region on export.
hint.parametric_patch: 💡 Parametric models generate patches directly on the selected face, with face boundary safety constraints.
hint.wall_region_desc: This is the wall region remaining after patches are subtracted. You can assign it a custom solid export name.
hint.before_bool_diff: Before Bool Diff is executed, you can drag the beam and projection vector. After success, the beam is hidden, only the generated regions remain, and you can only rename but not drag.
error.beam_size_invalid: ⛔ Beam size invalid, auto-clamped to safe range
btn.reset_proj_default: ↺ Reset to Current Face Default Projection
hint.fixed_value_t: This face applies fixedValue T boundary condition (simulating heat source surface temperature).
hint.perforated_cyclic: Perforated baffle generates cyclic master/slave patches with porousBafflePressure BC.
hint.region_patch_desc: Patches added on this region will be grouped under this region node, and will no longer appear as six projection view faces.
preview.root_desc: The current view directly uses the in-memory final STL export result for colored display, without writing files. Click a colored region in the left tree or viewport to check solid region names and partitioning.
preview.model_desc: This node shows the final exported STL solid regions of this model.
preview.region_desc: This is a solid block in the final STL. The color is for preview distinction only and will not be written to the STL file.
preview.toggle_model_title: Toggle visibility of this object and all its solid regions in STL preview
preview.toggle_region_title: Toggle visibility of only this solid region in STL preview
loading.csg_hint: (Processing large external surfaces may take a few seconds — do not close the page)

status.mesh_ready: ✅ Mesh ready — you can start solving
status.mesh_not_found: ❌ No mesh found — please run mesh generation first

export.dialog_desc: Select models to include in the STL (tree visibility does not affect export; all models are selected by default):

tooltip.view_cube: Drag to rotate view; click a face to switch to that normal view

meshengine.desc.snappy: blockMesh background grid with iterative snappyHexMesh refinement; supports parallel meshing.
meshengine.desc.dcCart: The repo's own cut-cell Cartesian mesher: one assembly pass, no rebuild loop; geometry, refinement and seeds are read from snappyHexMeshDict so patch names match the boundary conditions; with parallel mesh on it runs as MPI ranks that each cut one slab and reconstructParMesh joins them; faceZones go to createBaffles.
meshengine.desc.meshgen: The vendored MeshGenerator cut-cell engine (dc17): one meshgen-cli cfdrun --dc-mode pass over the browser-exported STLs, no snap. It emits the final boundary (baffle master/slave cyclic pairs + metadata), faceZones and zones directly, so blockMesh/snappyHexMesh/createBaffles/decomposePar are skipped; the runner assembles the polyMesh into Mesh/ under the dc17 keep-list (AMR extras stripped). Single process, thread-capped.
meshmode.desc.bodyFitted: Body-fitted: snappyHexMesh snap on. Cells conform to curved surfaces; near-wall cells deform, so non-orthogonality runs a little higher.
meshmode.desc.cartesianLocalized: Pure Cartesian: snap off, uniform background plus per-object octree refinement. No cross-domain refinement, fewest cells, orthogonal cells; boundaries come out as octree steps.
meshmode.desc.structured: Structured: snap off, background grid lines aligned to object faces, so boundaries are straight. Lines run through the whole domain, which costs cells but is the most robust.

lce.title: Liquid-cooling dynamic experiment
lce.introduction: Coupled CDU, pipe-network and cold-plate simulation. Pumps, heat exchangers and valves use replaceable mock parameters; equipment geometry and cold-plate parameters come from the current project.
lce.default_newton_assumptions: New experiments use differentiable Newton DAE. Preparing or exporting will save synthetic primary-side assumptions: 1 kg/s at 20°C, 0.02 m³ on each HX side, project-fluid cp/rho, and mock equipment/material curves. These are numerical assumptions, not measurements or vendor calibration.
lce.saved_mock_assumptions: This DAE uses saved synthetic equipment, primary-side storage and material parameters. Review the primary-circuit details and parameter pack before running; these inputs are not measured or vendor-calibrated.
lce.mock_description: Explicitly model finite primary-side flow and energy storage on both sides. Defaults: 1 kg/s at 20°C, with 0.02 m³ per side. Parameters are saved with the project and are not NV calibration.
lce.init_consistent: project storage initial values + consistent algebraic state

hint.sixsigma_desc: dcCart's first-layer floor and rack-cell floor. Empty = runner default (weld 1.2 mm, first layer 0.3 × level spacing, cap 5 mm). The readout below converts the current settings into the cell edge per surface class.
tooltip.weld_tolerance: An axis-aligned surface closer than this to a finest-level grid plane is moved onto it (m). 0 = off.
tooltip.first_layer_fraction: First-layer floor: each surface class is snapped onto grid planes within this fraction of its own level spacing, so no wall cell is thinner than that. 0 = off, 0.5 = snap everything (the recommended way).
tooltip.first_layer_max: Absolute cap on the first-layer floor (m); 0 = no cap.
tooltip.first_layer_gap: A gap between two solids wider than this is never sealed by the floor (m); -1 = same as the weld tolerance.
tooltip.rack_cell_min: Rack-region cell floor (m): the auto-raise that resolves the thinnest fan server never makes the cell smaller than this . Empty = uncapped.
tooltip.apply_sixsigma: Sets background 0.25 m, dcCart with 8 mesh ranks and a 300 s whole-mesh budget; weld 1.2 mm, first layer 0.3 x spacing capped at 5 mm, rack cells at least 17.5 mm. Keeps local refinement, cell count limit and seed points.
